subject: Hello young lady.
author: kevlar0
body:
I'm guilty of being a lurker just recently, just reading your stuff and not bothering to comment, I'm just a lazy so and so, As for gaming be it racing or shooting stuff, i'm on pretty much every night, normally till late, if you have rainbow 2 you are more than welcome to join me, theres always a few friend on that one. Or you could badger (not the scratchy type) me into racing you on Revenge i'm sure i could rustlle up a couple of old school burners.

 

He's not the messiah, he's a very naughty boy.

subject: Sorry, been busy...
author: SUFFUR
body:
But I have been reading your stuff, voting etc and reading and even posting on the Brother of the Box forums over here in Singapore. And plugged the site for any players over here/ there to you, who may still play? And Pysc I read so many sites, that most of your stuff though cool, is old news to me, so your going to have to give it a bit of a spin, to attract your readers, as you only get the lazy ones, that can't be bothered to look, lol. You do have a style, like I have my skcollob, but your going to need to do something, to blow their minds, not that is bad or anything. Add the word Burnout every other sentence, lol. And Revenge every other word, ;).

I was going to write some stuff to do with your Brandon Crisp post, but I thought I would leave that alone for a while, but does have to do with children playing games and not getting enough out door fun and the practice of climbing trees, and other extra curricular activities, as I was talking to some guy who works for the 'army' (it's a different job but thought i would not give to many details, in case he comes and finds me and trys to snuff me out, he could you know?) and he was say gaming is all well and good, but people need physical contact with real people and need to get out of the bubble of the games room and interact, and catch some 'bugs', inhale some pollen and scrape some knees, build an immune sytem and a real friends list on a phone somewhere, who might get them a real job in the future. But I thought that was way to early for that sort of thing, but it is sad though. And my heart does go out to the parents.

I went to see Bond today, and it's OK, looks good mind, but I do have issuses with it. I also saw the Hulk, with Tim Roth and Ed Norton, which was good for a super hero film, and I like the ending for future film.

And yes it is quiet, but I assume people are just playing new games, and Revenge is dying, lol, sorry Pysc! You may have to play Paradise, just to keep Kev company, hehe!

Anyhew I be tired, I had a nice day, but it was long, but I had fun, and I ate some chinese food today, true it was just plain noodles with some added chilli's but it's a start, right?

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

body: I dont know what planet your living on.....ive had a few good rooms both of an evening and of a morning infact id say the last 2 days burnout has been good....seen a few old faces return too which is always a good thing...dont get me wrong GOW2 is an awesome game but it also is very easy compared to the first GOW....i think the main killer will be COD5:World at War....but ill still be racing......:p
